Referral to ACES Medical Oncology
Level of Urgency
Routine Referral. Suspected or confirmed cancer with no rapidly progressing clinical signs. Examples: soft tissue sarcoma, stable mast cell tumor, anal sac mass, osteosarcoma, bladder mass, etc.
Urgent Referral (seen within 1-2 weeks). Suspected or confirmed cancer with progressive signs or clinical concern for rapid disease progression. Examples: Suspected/confirmed large cell lymphoma (clinically stable), rapidly growing mass.
Emergency Referral (seen within 1-2 days). Suspected or confirmed large cell lymphoma, acute leukemia, or hypercalcemia of malignancy with significant clinical decline.

Ready to visit ACES?
We proudly serve the pets of Madison, WI, and the surrounding areas, including Monona, Middleton, Verona, Sun Prairie, Fitchburg, Stoughton, Oregon, Lodi, Cottage Grove, Janesville, Beaver Dam, Reeseville, and Waunakee. We look forward to seeing you and your pet! To request an appointment, please call us!
Have a question?
Please complete our online form and a member of our team will get back to you as quickly as possible (typically in 1-2 days). If you have an urgent or emergent matter, please call us at
608-333-0500
